title: eriosema latifolium
intro: Eriosema latifolium, commonly known as Wild Bean, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Eriosema latifolium include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in managing various health issues. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
